title: Major improvements planned for Longford Nature Park to boost wildlife and public accessibility
summary: Longford Nature Park is set to benefit from a series of improvements designed to enhance wildlife habitats and make the site more accessible for visitors.

title: Coventry’s rich story told in a fresh new visitor guide
summary: Coventry has a brand new visitor guide to showcase the city’s rich heritage, diverse culture and outstanding visitor attractions.

title: The Hill Group successfully moves and stores historic grade II listed mural at City Centre South
summary: The Hill Group has successfully lifted and securely stored the Grade II listed Three Tuns Mural, one of Coventry’s most distinctive pieces of post-war public art.

title: New bus service to welcome Coventry City back to the Premier League
summary: Mayor Richard Parker has struck a deal to launch a direct bus service linking Coventry Arena and Coventry Railway Station, after a request from Coventry City Council and Coventry City Football Club.

title: Digital access for all: Coventry shows Government what's working
summary: Representatives from the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS) visited Coventry to learn about #CovConnects, the Council's digital inclusion programme.

title: Coventry students celebrate GCSE success as English and Maths results improve
summary: Thousands of Coventry students are celebrating their GCSE results today, with the city seeing encouraging improvements in both English and maths.
